statements.t: Our focus is on converting those assets into commercial projects through disciplined development, partnerships and capital formation.”
Stanley continued, “At Hood County, we moved the project from a powered site toward a commercial AI infrastructure project.
We have completed our owner’s project requirements and our Phase 1 design basis, and we are advancing into basis of design and schematic design.
We expect to achieve positive operating cash flow in the first quarter of 2027.”

Stanley concluded, “Looking ahead to year end and 2027, our priorities are to convert existing frameworks into definitive agreements, establish commercial relationships with customers and partners, secure financing to develop these projects while remaining disciplined about per-share value, and expand our portfolio of powered assets.
